units.text: In nineteen eighty-three, deep beneath a concrete bunker, an old man lay strapped to a metal table in total silence.
Every sensory nerve in his body had been surgically cut, leaving him unable to see, hear, smell, taste, or feel a single thing.
The scientists believed that without the five physical senses, human thought could reach the pure presence of God.
Instead, something else found him in the dark: hundreds of dead voices that refused to leave.
And before his heart stopped forever, he opened his blind eyes and delivered one final message.
Let us go back to the beginning.
In nineteen eighty-three, a team of deeply religious scientists gathered at an undisclosed research facility.
They had theorized that our physical senses cloud our awareness of eternity, and without them, a human could actually contact God by thought alone.
An elderly man who claimed he had nothing left to live for was the only test subject to volunteer.
To purge him of all stimuli, surgeons performed a complex operation, severing every sensory nerve connection leading into his brain.
Although the man retained full muscular function, he could no longer see, hear, taste, smell, or feel.
With no possible way to sense the outside world, he was completely alone with his thoughts.
This story is inspired by Gateway of the Mind, as published on the Creepypasta Wiki.
Scientists monitored him through one-way glass as he spoke aloud in jumbled, slurred sentences that he could not even hear.
After four days, the man claimed he was hearing hushed, unintelligible voices whispering inside his head.
Assuming it was merely an onset of psychosis, the researchers paid little attention to his concerns.
Two days later, the subject began to weep, crying out that he could hear his dead wife conversing with him.
He claimed he could communicate back through his thoughts, whispering: [subject]"She is right here with me."
The scientists were skeptical, until the man began reciting the private names and secrets of their own dead relatives.
He repeated personal truths that only their deceased spouses and parents could have known, driving a sizable portion of the team to abandon the facility.
After a week of conversing with the dead through his mind, the subject became intensely distressed, saying the voices were overwhelming his consciousness.
In every waking moment, he was bombarded by hundreds of spirits that refused to leave him alone.
He frequently threw his body against the padded walls, desperately seeking any sensation of physical pain.
He begged the scientists for heavy sedatives so he could escape the voices through sleep.
This tactic worked for three days, until violent night terrors began.
The subject repeatedly cried that in his dreams, the dead were no longer just voices; he could clearly see and hear them surrounding him.
Only a day later, he began to scream, clawing at his useless eyes in hopes of sensing something in the physical world.
The hysterical man said the voices were now deafening and hostile, speaking of hell and the end of the world.
For five agonizing hours, he shrieked the words: [subject]"No heaven! No forgiveness!"
He continually begged to be killed, but the remaining scientists were convinced they were close to touching God.
After another day, the subject could no longer form coherent sentences.
Seemingly mad, he began thrashing violently, biting at his own flesh in frenzy.
The scientists rushed into the chamber and strapped him flat against a metal table so he could not harm himself.
After hours of being tied down, the subject abruptly halted his struggling and screaming.
He stared blankly at the ceiling as teardrops silently streaked across his face.
For two whole weeks, he lay motionless and had to be manually rehydrated through intravenous fluids due to the constant crying.
Eventually, he turned his head and, despite his blindness, made direct, focused eye contact with a scientist for the first time in the study.
He whispered his final words: [subject]"I have spoken with God, and he has abandoned us."
And in that exact second, his vital signs stopped forever, with no apparent cause of death.
Would you have severed every sensory nerve to hear the voice of God?
